IF OBJECT_ID('D360.IBS_SALUTATIONTBL') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE D360.IBS_SALUTATIONTBL

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_SALUTATIONTBL (
    FCBS_Code   VARCHAR(10),
    FCBS_Desc   VARCHAR(20),
    CreditLens  VARCHAR(20),
    Valid       VARCHAR(20)
)

WITH (
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);
